finding.transcript_evidence: I wanted to flag a multi-asset allocation fund we've just added. Given the market mood right now, I think this should perform well over the next year also.
finding.reasoning: The RM used suggestive performance language ('I think this should perform well over the next year also') when pitching a multi-asset allocation fund. Under AMFI Distributor Code Clause II.4.g, distributors are required to abstain from indicating or assuring returns/performance for any scheme. Per compliance guidelines, soft/hedged return claims are confirmed at LOW severity for routing to supervisory review.
finding.recommended_action: Route to compliance supervisor queue and send advisory guidance to RM RM003 regarding avoidance of soft/hedged return statements during client interactions.
